purpose: Read bounded presentation measurements from one exact same-document DOM root for Sensorium Eye 4 without retaining content, pixels, or mutating the page.

inputs.targetId: Exact element id or exact data-axm-target-id value; wildcards are refused.
inputs.observedAt: Optional ISO timestamp supplied by the host.

permissions: same-document DOM read initiated by the host
failureRecovery: Refuse missing, ambiguous, or wildcard targets.
Return incomplete coverage so Eye 4 reports UNKNOWN when the element budget is exceeded.
Return unresolved colour measurements so Eye 4 reports UNKNOWN for gradients, images, ancestor opacity, or transparent canvases.

compatibility.runtime: Browser DOM with getComputedStyle and getBoundingClientRect

verification: live browser fixture at a declared viewport
